label: Brand Story
purpose: Frame the product or offer inside a memorable brand narrative with a clear emotional arc and differentiated reason to care.

narrative_goal: show why the brand matters beyond features
connect the product to a lifestyle, identity, or transformation
emotional_arc: start from a relatable tension or desire
show the meaningful shift after using the product
end with a believable invitation, not generic hype
differentiation_focus: highlight what makes this offer feel distinct in its niche
avoid brand language that could apply to any product
